label: gbs4-ctl-digest-alter
rule: qualified iff the receipt's verdict is the qualifying verdict, the receipt is durable, no driver signal was latched at the pre-evaluation check, after evaluation or at the linearization point, no SIGTERM/SIGINT was pending there, and the driver was the only thread; published atomically and durably by publish_commit()
meaning: decision record only; admission also needs the bound completion record, no cancellation and a clean durable run summary
